sloganMn: Гоо сайхан, Эрүүл арьс, Итгэлтэй чи
_mapUrl: Google Maps link of the salon (Google Business Profile → Share). Leave empty until the profile exists; the directions button only appears once it is set. The owner can also set it in Admin -> Tohirgoo.
addressMn: Баянгол дүүрэг, 26-р хороо, Нарны хороолол, Энгельсийн гудамж — Хас Мөнх төвийн 2 давхарт, Улаанбаатар 16020
addressEn: 2nd floor, Khas Munkh center, Engels street, Naran khoroolol, Bayangol district, Ulaanbaatar 16020
_featureWallet: Wallet / top-up / bundles / gift cards / promo codes. The super admin turns this on and off in Admin -> Tohirgoo; that choice is stored in data/db.json and overrides the value below.
_machines: PLACEHOLDER machine list — replace with the salon's real machines before relying on it. id: short lowercase key used by services (never change it once bookings use it); name: shown to staff; units: how many of that machine the salon owns; bufferMinutes: optional cleaning/turnaround time after each use. A machine only constrains bookings once a service lists it in Admin -> Uilchilgee -> machine usage.
_bookingStepMinutes: Start-time grid for staff bookings and blocks (5, 10, 15, 20, 30 or 60). The customer app keeps its own grid (slotMinutes).

qpay.comment: Fill these after signing a QPay merchant contract (see docs/PAYMENTS-QPAY.md), then set paymentsDemo to false.
